illustrations.text: A slashes B with a knife but the injury is a shallow cut only. Hurt by a stabbing instrument: up to three years or Rs 20,000 under s.118(1) - and non-bailable.
A stabs B with a knife, causing grievous hurt. s.118(2): imprisonment for life, or one to ten years, and fine.
A punch is not a dangerous means; the case belongs to s.115.
A hunter's shot accidentally hits B. Not voluntary, so s.118 is not engaged; the negligence track is s.125.
